excerpt.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着黄金之幻梦安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在黄金之幻梦的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。

texts.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the Golden Dream.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with the Golden Dream. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

label.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.

summary.text:
# 思想游戏 / Thoughtplay

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求与小赞助者“黄金之幻梦”已完成接触、未在“自寻出路”、处于月窠或器具领域之一，每个帝国一次。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires completed contact with the minor patron the Golden Dream, not forging its own path, and being in the domain of the Cradle or the Instrument; once per empire.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

我们发现自己身处黄金之幻梦的一局游戏。

We find ourselves inside a game of the Golden Dream.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：解锁法令“闲适之意”。

Only option: unlocks the edict Will of Distraction.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
